group_trips.title: Dubai Desert, Skyline and Abu Dhabi Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip through Dubai's skyline, souks and dunes to Abu Dhabi's grand mosque and Louvre, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
This small-group trip brings together the two UAE cities most travellers want to see. You begin in Dubai with a Marina dhow cruise, a city tour and a visit to the Burj Khalifa observation deck, then head into the dunes for an evening desert safari.

A day in Abu Dhabi follows, with the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the Corniche waterfront. Returning to Dubai, you have a relaxed final day before departure. A trip captain stays with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.

group_trips.title: Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure group trip from the Dubai skyline to the mountains of Ras Al Khaimah and the heritage quarter of Sharjah, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
Most visitors see only Dubai. This group trip adds two more emirates, giving you a fuller picture of the UAE in six days. You see Dubai's landmarks, Dubai Frame and the old souks, then travel north to Ras Al Khaimah for the mountain scenery of Jebel Jais and a night by the coast.

On the way back you stop in Sharjah for its mosque, lagoon and traditional markets before a final day in Dubai with the Burj Khalifa observation deck. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.

Burj Khalifa observation deck and a trip captain throughout

group_trips.title: Dubai Weekend Escape: Skyline, Desert and Abu Dhabi
group_trips.summary: A relaxed Friday-to-Monday break in Dubai with the Burj Khalifa, old Dubai, a desert safari and a day in Abu Dhabi, led by a trip captain.
group_trips.overview:
Dubai is one of the easiest places in the world to enjoy over a long weekend, and this fixed-departure escape is planned around exactly that. You land early on Friday, settle into a 4-star hotel and are out seeing the city the same afternoon, with one or two headline sights each day and plenty of room to breathe.

The programme brings together Dubai's modern skyline at the Burj Khalifa, the old creek-side souks and Dubai Frame, the coast at Jumeirah Beach and Palm Jumeirah, and an evening in the dunes with a camp dinner. A full day is set aside for Abu Dhabi, where you visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the Louvre Abu Dhabi before returning to Dubai.

You travel with a trip captain and a small group, with Indian meal options on request. Because the trip is short, we suggest flights that arrive early on day 1 and leave late on the last day.

Dubai Frame and the old Creek-side Gold and Spice Souks
Photo stops at Jumeirah Beach, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah
Evening desert safari with dune bashing and a camp BBQ dinner
Full-day Abu Dhabi visit: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Louvre Abu Dhabi

honeymoon_trips.title: Dubai Honeymoon: Skyline Views, Dhow Dinner and Desert Sunset
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private five-night Dubai honeymoon with a flower welcome, a private city tour, the Burj Khalifa, a desert sunset, a couples spa session, a Marina dhow cruise and a candlelight dinner.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
Dubai suits a honeymoon because it offers glamour and quiet in equal measure. This five-night private trip gives you a sea-view or city-view room, late starts and one special experience each day, with a private car and guide for every sightseeing outing.

You are welcomed with flowers or a cake on arrival, see the skyline from the Burj Khalifa observation deck, watch the sun go down over the dunes and spend an evening on a dhow gliding through Dubai Marina. A couples spa session and a candlelight dinner are set aside for the slow days, and old Dubai's creek and souks add a touch of history.

The pace is yours. Mornings are unhurried, evenings are free, and every honeymoon touch is arranged in advance so you simply turn up and enjoy it.

honeymoon_trips.title: Dubai and Abu Dhabi Honeymoon with a Night in the Desert
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night honeymoon across Dubai and Abu Dhabi, with a night at a desert camp, a candlelight dinner under the stars, the Grand Mosque, the Louvre Abu Dhabi, a couples spa and a Marina dhow cruise.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
This honeymoon pairs the two great cities of the UAE with something rarer: a full night in the desert. You begin in Dubai with a welcome of flowers or a cake, a private city tour and the Burj Khalifa, then drive out to a desert camp or resort for sunset, a candlelight dinner under the stars and a sunrise over the dunes.

From there you travel by private car to Abu Dhabi for the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, the Louvre Abu Dhabi and a walk along the Corniche, with a free afternoon and a couples spa session to slow things down.

You return to Dubai for a final evening on a dhow cruise through the Marina. Every transfer and outing is private, mornings start late and each day has just one highlight, so the holiday never feels rushed.
highlights: Flower or cake welcome and bed decoration on arrival, subject to availability
Private Dubai city tour and the Burj Khalifa observation deck
A night at a desert camp or resort with a candlelight dinner under the stars
Sunset dune drive and a quiet sunrise in the desert
Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the Louvre Abu Dhabi with a private guide
Couples spa session in Abu Dhabi
Marina dhow cruise with dinner on board on the last evening

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai | Welcome and Marina Stroll
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Dubai airport, where you are met and taken by private car to your hotel.
Check in to a room chosen for couples, with a flower or cake welcome and bed decoration, subject to availability.
Rest after your journey and keep the afternoon free.
In the evening, take an easy walk along the Marina promenade.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Private City Tour | Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description:
After a late breakfast, set out on a private city tour with photo stops at Jumeirah Beach, Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah.
Visit Dubai Frame for views across old and new Dubai.
Rest at the hotel through the afternoon.
In the evening, go up the Burj Khalifa observation deck and watch the Dubai Mall fountain show.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Dubai to the Desert | Candlelight Dinner under the Stars
itinerary.description:
After a slow breakfast, check out and enjoy a free late morning.
In the afternoon, drive by private car to your desert camp or resort, subject to availability.
Watch the sunset from the dunes, with a dune drive and a short camel ride where offered.
Enjoy a candlelight dinner under the stars.
Overnight stay in the desert.

itinerary.title: Desert Sunrise | Abu Dhabi and the Grand Mosque
itinerary.description:
Wake to a quiet sunrise over the dunes and enjoy a leisurely breakfast.
Drive by private car to Abu Dhabi.
Visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, one of the largest mosques in the world, with your private guide.
Check in to your hotel and walk along the Corniche in the evening.
Overnight stay in Abu Dhabi.

itinerary.title: Louvre Abu Dhabi | Couples Spa
itinerary.description:
After a late breakfast, visit the Louvre Abu Dhabi with your private guide.
Spend the afternoon at leisure, with a couples spa session at a spa chosen for you, subject to availability.
Choose a dinner spot in the evening, or ask us to suggest one.
Overnight stay in Abu Dhabi.

itinerary.title: Return to Dubai | Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and travel by private car back to Dubai.
Check in to your hotel and rest through the afternoon.
In the evening, board a dhow for a cruise through Dubai Marina, with dinner on board.
Overnight stay in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dubai
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and a free morning.
Check out around 12 noon.
Transfer by private car to Dubai airport for your onward flight.
Depart with memories of the Emirates.
